From the manufacturer

Hi. We make water bottles.

Why? Well, we’re a motley crew of dreamers and designers who live by a simple creed: “Do more of what you love.”​

And we love designing things that make life a little bit easier and a heckuva a lot more enjoyable. We asked ourselves, with so many different kinds of water bottles out there, why do 3 out of 4 people still suffer from chronic dehydration?

So we rolled up our sleeves and got to work. We created what we believe to be the finest water bottles in all the land. Water bottles designed to help you do more of what you love. So, what are you waiting for? Go forth and carpe the diem—hydrated like a boss.

I’m the perfect addition to the FreeSip family.

As a versatile spin on a classic, I love a window seat on the plane or a purse pocket for a night out.

I’ve got a sleek shape that’s effortless to get in and out of bags, a carry loop so you never miss a beat, and drinks that stay cold for 24 hours.

Oh and if you’re into hot and carbonated drinks, I can handle that too.

Features

  • 18 or 24 oz
  • Triple layer insulated
  • Patented FreeSip spout with a built- in straw
  • Leakproof twist-top lid
  • Holds hot, cold, and carbonated drinks
  • Carry loop
  • BPA, lead, and phthalate-free
  • Easy to clean

Sip and Swig

What makes the Owala FreeSip so different than other bottles? The FreeSip has a patented 2-in-1 spout that rocks BOTH a built-in straw for sipping AND a wide-mouth opening for chugging. That’s right—two different ways to drink.

Keeps Drinks Cold

Triple-layered, vacuum-insulated stainless steel keeps drinks cold for up to 24-hours. Plus, this bottle is made from BPA- and phthalate-free materials.

Take it anywhere

Because you'll want to take this bottle everywhere, the 24-Ounce bottles are cup-holder friendly. With a carry loop, you can stay hydrated on-the-go.

Product Description

The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid easily tackles every thirst. With a built-in, easy-clean straw and a wide-mouth opening, the FreeSip reusable bottle is designed for drinking two different ways: sipping upright through the straw or tilting back to swig from the wide-mouth spout opening. Add in a push-to-open lid and playful colors, and staying hydrated has never been simpler—or more fun. Additional features include double-wall insulated stainless steel that keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours, a carry loop that doubles as a lock, a cup holder-friendly base, and a wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice. The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid is available in three sizes: 24-Ounce, 32-Ounce, and 40-Ounce. Lid is dishwasher safe; hand wash cup. Not for use with hot liquids. Manufacturer’s limited lifetime warranty.

    Is it possible for a water bottle to improve your life?
    Reviewed in the United States on April 7, 2026

    I don't know what kind of mad scientist they have working for Owala, but can we get this guy working on improving other things, like those gas pumps that always shut off every $.05 cents, or maybe invent a cell phone screen protector that doesn't crack a week after you put it on? Seriously, what an amazing design they have. I love the Owala spouts. I detest water bottles with straws, except for Owala. These things are so pleasant to drink out of. Also, this lid is fantastic, it's leak proof, easy to remove (Stanley, take a look, this is better), and that little string loop thing goes great over your middle finger. That's the strongest point, and if someone messes with you swing that thing like a club! Seriously, don't go around just hitting people, but as a self-defense item this will work! It kept my ice water nice and cold today. They claim you can put other stuff in here, but really, why would you? It's such a fantastic water bottle. I guess if you wanted to load it up with coffee, tea, soda, or any number of adult beverages that's up to you. I just don't want to stain up the inside. The 18 ounce fits perfectly in my backpack's water bottle pocket. I have the Bellroy Transit Workpack Pro 28L. I bought this to take with me when I fly. Empty water bottles are allowed thru security, then fill it up after going through security. It'll save you a bunch on bottled water. If you want something easy to carry, fits any cup holder, and can hold enough water to quench your thirst for a reasonable amount of time the 18 ounce is perfect. If you're one of those people that likes to carry enough water for a full day of hiking on the AT this probably isn't for you. For the rest of us it's perfect! Great job Owala!

    I absolutely love my Owala FreeSip Twist water bottle! First, I love that it’s cup holder-friendly, lightweight, and easy to carry around without feeling bulky. It’s perfect for everyday use.

    One of my favorite features is that you can either sip or chug from the same bottle. I personally prefer sipping because it’s so refreshing, especially with ice-cold water. The insulation is amazing—my ice stays frozen for hours, even on hot California days, so I always have a cold drink when I need one.

    I also think it’s reasonably priced for the quality you get. The denim color is simple, clean, and goes with everything. I use it every single day, and it has quickly become one of my favorite water bottles.

    As much as I like my Stanley, I honestly reach for my Owala more often. My Stanley is great for certain occasions and the aesthetic, but the Owala wins when it comes to everyday practicality and functionality. I would absolutely buy another one if I ever needed to.

    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I'm a big fan of Owala especially their FreeSip spout bottles. I already have the original design in the 24oz and 32oz, I also have the Sway in 40oz and now I was looking for a smaller bottle that is easier to travel with and this FreeSip Twist 18oz is the one! I do have to get used to the twist off cap that's not attached to the bottle since it's not as quick or easy to use as a push button attached lid. It is leak proof as advertised but beware that if you have ice water in your bottle and you have it laying on its side, the cap and right at the fill to area will form condensation (just like the other Owala bottles). I also like how this bottle can carry carbonated or hot liquids (the other Owalas do not recommend it). It is fairly easy to take apart and clean but coming from larger bottles where I can usually fit my hand in it to clean, this one you definitely need to invest in a bottle cleaning brush if you don't have one already. I hope Owala doesn't come out with other styles of FreeSip bottles because I'm just going to keep growing my collection! I love this Dreamy Fields color which seems to only be available through Amazon, it's a very subtle pink to the point where it looks almost white online but when placed next to my Shy Marshmallow (white bottle), you can clearly see the difference. I do wish Owala made a bottle boot that would fit this bottle, I ordered a generic one but it is just slightly too loose but it is still better than nothing since I don't want to scratch or dent the bottom of the bottle (btw, the Owala boots are the best quality ones you can get). The thin shape of this bottle is easy to grab and it does fit in the side pocket of my Baggallini Securetex Vacation backpack purse (you can look it up for reference) and it fits inside of that bag too (that's why I opted for the 18oz vs the 24oz one). The quality is great as usual and it does keep ice water cold for a long time. I do think that Amazon should improve the packaging on this type of item because it was shipped in the brown paper bag that no longer has any type of cushioning and this is a stainless steel bottle so I'm surprised and grateful that there were no dents or scratches when I received it (especially when I saw the delivery guy just throw the package onto my cement stairs). I did order multiple items hoping it would ship in 1 box but it was shipped separately on its own (my other items did come in a box).

    Great insulation and durability after almost a year
    Reviewed in the United States on August 19, 2026
    Color: Foggy TideSize: 24 Ounces

    I’ve been using this Owala for almost a year, and it has held up really well. As I mentioned in my video, my partner uses it every day for work in construction. When we add ice, it stays cold for a long time, and the ice can last up to around 10 hours without completely melting.

    The outside has gotten a little scratched and worn from regular use, but the bottle itself still works perfectly. I really like how well it keeps drinks cold.

    The only thing that took some getting used to was closing the lid. At first, it can be a little tricky to close when you’re in a hurry. Also, sometimes the drinking opening ends up facing the opposite direction when you open it. There is a small marking that shows you the correct position, so once you get used to it, it’s not really an issue.

    Overall, I really like this bottle, especially for its insulation and durability. After almost a year of regular use, I’m still happy with it.

    5 out of 5 stars
    Durable, Leak-Proof, and Love the Two Sip Options!!
    Reviewed in the United States on January 22, 2026
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    I am absolutely in love with this water bottle. I go through water bottles way too often because they either break, get gross, or start leaking, but this one has been amazing so far. It feels heavy-duty and very durable, which immediately set it apart from others I’ve owned.

    I was originally drawn to the different color options (I got Dreamy Field), but what really sold me was the two drinking options - you can sip through the straw or take a regular swig. It’s such a simple feature, but it makes a big difference depending on what you’re doing. Plus, I've found it makes drinking water so much more enjoyable lol!

    Another thing I really appreciate is the rubber seal. It’s much thicker and more heavy-duty than the thin seals on most bottles, so I don’t have to worry about spills or leaks at all. It feels very secure. It’s also easy to take apart for cleaning, which is huge for me since bottles can get gross fast if they’re hard to wash.

    The size is perfect - not too big and not too small - and I love that it comes with a built-in strap at the top for carrying. A lot of similar bottles don’t include that, and it’s surprisingly annoying when they don’t.

    I haven’t tested it with ice yet, so I can’t speak to that specifically, but my cold water does stay cold for a long time. Overall, this is a great bottle that looks good, feels high quality, and is very practical for everyday use. It's totally worth the money and definitely one of my favorite water bottles I’ve owned.

About this Item

  • 24-ounce double-walled insulated stainless-steel water bottle holds hot, cold, and carbonated drinks
  • Patented FreeSip spout designed for either sipping upright through the built-in straw or tilting back to swig from the spout opening
  • Protective leak proof twist-top; convenient carry loop for easy transport
  • BPA, lead, and phthalate-free
  • Hand-washable, Warranty: Standard

Product Description

The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid easily tackles every thirst. With a built-in, easy-clean straw and a wide-mouth opening, the FreeSip reusable bottle is designed for drinking two different ways: sipping upright through the straw or tilting back to swig from the wide-mouth spout opening. Add in a push-to-open lid and playful colors, and staying hydrated has never been simpler—or more fun. Additional features include double-wall insulated stainless steel that keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours, a carry loop that doubles as a lock, a cup holder-friendly base, and a wide opening for easy cleaning and adding ice. The Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless-Steel Water Bottle with Locking Push-Button Lid is available in three sizes: 24-Ounce, 32-Ounce, and 40-Ounce. Lid is dishwasher safe; hand wash cup. Not for use with hot liquids. Manufacturer’s limited lifetime warranty.
